content: We looked at the automatic corrections for 100 erroneous sentences of English and Estonian each as well as 80 sentences of Latvian. The overall aim was to find the ratio of sentences where (1) all errors have been corrected (2) only some are corrected (3) only some are corrected and part of the meaning is changed and (4) all meaning is lost.
